title: Question Assignment Tool
instruction_1: 1. Paste the list of students, one student per line (use a blank line to separate student groups).
instruction_2: 2. Paste the list of theoretical questions, one question per line.
instruction_3: 3. Select how many theoretical questions per student will be assigned.
instruction_4: 4. Select the Total Grade and set its percentage distribution between Defense and Theory.
instruction_5: 5. Paste the list of practice questions (optional), one question per line.
instruction_6: 6. Click 'GENERATE EXCEL' to create the Excel assignment questions file.
instruction_7: 7. Open the generated file from current location and evaluate the students.
error_message: An error occurred while generating the Excel file. Check the log file for more details.
mixed_tags: Some questions have tags while others do not. Please ensure that all questions have tags or none have tags.
invalid_tags: One or more questions have an invalid tag format. Please use the format [TAG] Question.
tag_distribution_all: ALL students have questions from different topics.
tag_distribution_some: SOME students have more than one question from the SAME topic.
grade_note: CLARIFICATION: The grade shown is a reference based solely on the student's answers to the questions. The final grade will be affected by the quality of the student's defense and presentation, which are an integral part of the overall assessment.
